run_submitit_linprobe: run the submitit_linprobe script to submit a multi-node MAE linear probe training job via SLURM
run_parse_args: run parse_args to build an argument parser for configuring GPU nodes, timeout, and partition
run_get_shared_folder: run get_shared_folder to create and return a shared experiment directory path under /checkpoint
run_get_init_file: run get_init_file to generate a unique init file path for distributed training synchronization
run_trainer_call: run the Trainer class to set up GPU arguments and execute the MAE linear probe classification main function
